card.title: I Pulled Away First
card.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Before your taxi comes, let's restart our letters. I've brought paper and stamps.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You never answered my last three.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: The post's been terrible. We can write the first ones here, bypass the whole system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I handed you the last one.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Even better. Sit down; I'll write yours first. You can watch until there's enough to take home.

mechanism: A urgently rebuilds correspondence while deflecting the evidence that A's unanswered letters caused the distance.
confusable: Unlike a candid apology, A must offer concrete repair while avoiding acknowledgment of personal causation.
comparison: D85-a offers witnessed immediate writing; D85-b offers new keys and a birthday ritual without admitting the exclusion.
provenance: Direct local assistant candidate preparation; not fresh review or acceptance.
